requirements.Title: NGB Keyed Bottles with High Page Yield
requirements.Description: Develop new NGB keyed ink bottles with 6K Black and 6K CMY page yield; CMY bottle size must support >8K pages.
requirements.Rationale: To increase ink capacity and reduce customer intervention, supporting higher print volumes and competitive positioning.
requirements.Dependencies: Ink formulation compatibility, bottle manufacturing updates
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Bottles must be able to deliver at least 6,000 pages (Black/CMY) and >8,000 pages (CMY) as validated by standardized yield tests.

requirements.Title: Spill-Free Reliability for Ink Bottles
requirements.Description: Ensure the new ink bottles and tank system deliver spill-free reliability during user refill and maintenance operations.
requirements.Rationale: Improves user experience and minimizes mess/errors, reducing support costs and customer complaints.
requirements.Dependencies: Bottle and tank design, IDS integration
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Less than 1% of user refill events result in ink spills, as measured in field trials and lab tests.

requirements.Title: NOA-F with Metal Foiled Labyrinth and Lid Label
requirements.Description: Integrate NOA-F (Non-OEM Accessory-Filter) with a metal foiled labyrinth and lid label. No changes to click-on push-push and TDF mechanisms.
requirements.Rationale: Enhances security, reliability, and differentiation from competitors while maintaining user familiarity.
requirements.Dependencies: NOA-F supply chain, mechanical design constraints
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: NOA-F units must pass reliability and security tests with the new labyrinth and label, and be compatible with existing mechanisms.

requirements.Title: Reuse SuperAmp Si PHA and Magi/Nessie Ink
requirements.Description: Leverage existing SuperAmp Si PHA hardware and Magi/Nessie pigment ink without reformulation.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces R&D cost, accelerates time-to-market, and leverages proven technology.
requirements.Dependencies: Compatibility of new system with legacy components
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: 100% compatibility of reused components in prototype and pilot production builds.

requirements.Title: Ink System Reliability and Characterization
requirements.Description: Model and characterize reliability, water vapor transmission rate (WVTR), air gain, flow rate, and IDS including startup and NOA-F end-of-life.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures consistent print quality and system reliability over product lifecycle.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Validated models and test data for all key reliability metrics before design freeze.

requirements.Title: Ink Stability Modeling and PQ Impact Analysis
requirements.Description: Model ink stability in the tank and analyze its impact on print quality (PQ).
requirements.Rationale: Maintains high print quality and reduces risk of ink degradation over time.
requirements.Dependencies: Access to ink chemistry data, tank design
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Documented ink stability model and PQ impact report reviewed and approved by R&D.

requirements.Title: NOA-F as Service Parts in Warranty Support
requirements.Description: NOA-F must be available as service parts for warranty support and field replacements.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures serviceability and customer satisfaction during warranty period.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: NOA-F service parts available in service centers within 3 months of product launch.

requirements.Title: Acumen 6 on Lid
requirements.Description: Integrate Acumen 6 technology onto the ink bottle lid for authentication or tracking.
requirements.Rationale: Improves anti-counterfeiting and supply chain traceability.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Acumen 6 feature fully functional and passes security validation tests.

requirements.Title: Modify Factory Line for NOA-F and New Bottles
requirements.Description: Modify SA14 production line for NOA-F assembly; add Magi ink cart and labeling tool in Orcus 5. Mold for 1-4 new keyed caps required.
requirements.Rationale: Supports manufacturing of new consumables and assemblies.
requirements.Dependencies: Factory retooling schedules, cap design finalization
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Factory lines operational and producing new components at required yield rates before launch.

requirements.Title: Support Customer-Replaceable PHA and NOA-F
requirements.Description: Design the system to allow customers to easily replace PHA (Printhead Assembly) and NOA-F without professional service.
requirements.Rationale: Improves user experience and reduces service costs.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Replacement process can be performed by end users in under 5 minutes with no tools, as validated in usability studies.

requirements.Title: New Warranty Page Life Goal: 80K Pages
requirements.Description: Set and support a new warranty page life goal of 80,000 pages for the printer.
requirements.Rationale: Extends product life and supports higher duty cycle use-cases, competitive advantage.
requirements.Dependencies: Component durability, consumable yield, warranty policy
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer must reliably print 80,000 pages without major failure, as verified in accelerated life testing.

requirements.Title: Reddington ID with Increased Tank Size
requirements.Description: Adopt Reddington ID with a size increase for the ink tank. No change to Marconi-HI ADF (Automatic Document Feeder).
requirements.Rationale: Supports higher ink capacity and aligns with existing industrial design.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: New tank design integrated into Reddington ID and passes mechanical and aesthetic validation.

requirements.Title: EPS Foam Packaging
requirements.Description: Utilize EPS foam packaging for the printer and consumables.
requirements.Rationale: Protects product during shipping and handling.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Products pass drop and vibration tests with EPS packaging.

requirements.Title: EPEAT3, LOT4, and Blue Angel Certification for PDL SKU
requirements.Description: Ensure compliance with EPEAT3, LOT4, and Blue Angel environmental standards for the PDL SKU.
requirements.Rationale: Meets regulatory and market requirements for sustainability and eco-labels.
requirements.Dependencies: Design and material choices, certification processes
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: PDL SKU achieves EPEAT3, LOT4, and Blue Angel certifications before launch.

requirements.Title: Input/Output Tray Modifications for Tank Protrusion
requirements.Description: Modify input and output trays to align with the increased tank protrusion.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures mechanical compatibility and usability.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Trays function correctly with new tank and pass fit/form/function tests.

requirements.Title: Size Optimization of Printer
requirements.Description: Optimize overall printer size, considering the increased tank and new components.
requirements.Rationale: Maintains competitive footprint and maximizes desk space efficiency.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Final product dimensions do not exceed agreed size envelope and pass ergonomic review.

requirements.Title: 4.3” CGD Display Integration
requirements.Description: Integrate a 4.3” CGD (Color Graphic Display) into the printer for enhanced user interface.
requirements.Rationale: Improves user experience and modernizes product appearance.
requirements.Dependencies: Electrical and mechanical integration, UI software
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Display is fully functional and passes usability and reliability tests.

requirements.Title: 4-Tube Platform with Sayan Sibstar Tubes and New Routing
requirements.Description: Leverage Sayan Sibstar tubes, introduce new tube routing and integration for the 4-tube platform.
requirements.Rationale: Supports new ink system architecture and reliability.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Tube routing supports reliable ink delivery and passes stress and reliability tests.

requirements.Title: Service Station Aerosol Management
requirements.Description: Update service station for aerosol management with spit platform changes due to new tank design.
requirements.Rationale: Prevents contamination and maintains print quality.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Aerosol emissions are within regulatory and HP internal limits.

requirements.Title: Carriage Dynamic and Force Model Update
requirements.Description: Update carriage dynamic and force models to account for new tube routing and weights.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures mechanical reliability and print quality with new system configuration.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Carriage operates within force budget and passes mechanical reliability tests.

requirements.Title: Paper Path Support for Increased Page Life
requirements.Description: Redesign paper path to support increased page life (80K pages).
requirements.Rationale: Ensures durability and reliability for higher duty cycles.
requirements.Dependencies: Paper path material and design updates
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Paper path components pass 80K page accelerated wear tests.

requirements.Title: Ink Maintenance Serviceable Part Post 80K Life
requirements.Description: Design ink maintenance as a serviceable part to be replaced at service centers after 80K page life.
requirements.Rationale: Extends printer usable life and supports high-volume users.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Service centers can replace part in <30 minutes; validated in pilot service program.

requirements.Title: 140ml K and XXml CMY Bottles
requirements.Description: Introduce new 140ml Black (K) bottles and appropriately sized CMY bottles for the new system.
requirements.Rationale: Aligns with increased yield and system design.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Bottles meet yield and compatibility requirements in system validation tests.

requirements.Title: New Make-Break and FI Connection for IDS
requirements.Description: Develop new make-break and fluidic interconnect (FI) connection for the IDS (Ink Delivery System).
requirements.Rationale: Improves reliability and serviceability of the ink system.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: New connection passes leak, durability, and usability tests.

requirements.Title: Increased Size, Keying, and LOI for LEBI Ink-Tank
requirements.Description: Increase LEBI (Low-End Bulk Ink) ink-tank size, implement new keying, and integrate LOI (Level of Integration) with one SHAID (Security Hardware Authentication ID).
requirements.Rationale: Prevents misinstallation, supports higher capacity, and enhances security.
requirements.Dependencies: Tank and keying design, SHAID integration
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Tank passes installation, capacity, and security validation tests.

requirements.Title: New IDS Startup Algorithm and Air Management
requirements.Description: Develop a new IDS startup algorithm and air management system for reliable operation.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures consistent startup and prevents air entrapment issues.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: System starts up reliably in 99% of power-on cycles in lab and field tests.

requirements.Title: New Servicing and Startup Algorithm
requirements.Description: Implement new servicing and startup algorithms for improved reliability and user experience.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces errors and improves printer uptime.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Algorithms reduce startup and servicing errors by 50% over previous generation in controlled trials.

requirements.Title: New PQ Goals and Depletion Definition
requirements.Description: Establish new print quality (PQ) goals and depletion definitions to align with new page yield targets.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures product meets customer expectations and marketing claims.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: PQ and depletion metrics approved by cross-functional team and validated in system tests.

requirements.Title: Reuse Marconi Tux dASIC, Hannibal aASIC, Raccoon PSU, Stingray Wi-Fi, Dune FW
requirements.Description: Leverage existing Marconi Tux dASIC, Hannibal aASIC, Raccoon PSU, Stingray Wi-Fi module, and Dune firmware for the new printer.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces development time and leverages proven, reliable components.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All reused components function as required in system integration tests.

requirements.Title: Gauss4.xx Security (HW & FW)
requirements.Description: Integrate Gauss4.xx hardware and firmware security features into the printer.
requirements.Rationale: Protects product and user data from security threats.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Security features pass internal and external penetration testing.

requirements.Title: Speed: 25/20 ppm (PDL: 25/19 ppm)
requirements.Description: Printer must support print speeds of 25/20 pages per minute (ppm) for standard and 25/19 ppm for PDL SKU.
requirements.Rationale: Meets market expectations for performance and competitiveness.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer achieves required speeds in standardized performance tests.

requirements.Title: Serviceability: Maintenance Box
requirements.Description: Design printer with a serviceable maintenance box for easy end-user or service center replacement.
requirements.Rationale: Improves uptime and reduces repair costs.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Box can be replaced in under 10 minutes by trained personnel or end users.

requirements.Title: SMB Solution and PaaS Support
requirements.Description: Support SMB solution features and Printer-as-a-Service (PaaS) business models.
requirements.Rationale: Expands addressable market and supports new revenue streams.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer integrates with SMB solution and PaaS platforms as required by business model.

requirements.Title: Host 12K-CMYK and Trade Page 6K
requirements.Description: Support hosting of 12K-CMYK and trade page yield of 6K as flexible business requirements.
requirements.Rationale: Provides flexibility for different market segments and promotions.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer supports 12K-CMYK and 6K trade page configurations as validated in market trials.

requirements.Title: Solution and Services Integration: Scan, Manageability, Enterprise Support
requirements.Description: Integrate scan solutions, SMB manageability, and enterprise support including WJA (Web Jetadmin), HPSM, JAM.
requirements.Rationale: Meets enterprise and SMB customer requirements for fleet management and workflow.
requirements.Stakeholders: Enterprise IT, SMB Customers, Product Management
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All solution features are functional and validated in enterprise and SMB pilot deployments.

requirements.Title: Client and Driver Support: HPX, PSA, SUPD, UPD, EasyStart, USS, UFD
requirements.Description: Ensure compatibility with HPX, PSA, SUPD, UPD, EasyStart, USS, and UFD clients and drivers.
requirements.Rationale: Maximizes compatibility and ease of use for customers across segments.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All listed clients and drivers are supported and pass compatibility tests.
